why: Turns 'one axis never moved, so the question is undefined' into 'measured, and the axes are independent' -- the opposite claim, and the more flattering one. The correlation is the figure this module tells a reader to consult BEFORE coverage, because on the shipped boards every candidate axis pair runs |r| 0.78-0.95 and a grid over two of them is close to one-dimensional. A fake 0 there would present a degenerate sample as the ideal case.
killedBy: expressive range: coverage is not reported without its axes correlation returns null rather than zero when an axis never moved
